summary.text: Dan Helmer is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 10, representing part of Fairfax County, serving since 2020. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Counties, Cities and Towns (chair), Labor and Commerce, Public Safety, and Rules.

paragraphs.text: Dan Helmer was born in New Brunswick, New Jersey, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says he earned a B.Sc. from the United States Military Academy in 2003 and an M.Phil. from the University of Oxford in 2006, and lists his occupation as management consultant.
The profile lists his military service as the U.S. Army from 2003 to 2014 and the Army Reserve from 2014 to 2024.
It shows him chairing the Counties, Cities and Towns Committee and the Studies Subcommittee of Rules.
